meta.name: BASS FORGE
meta.author: MODDYS Foundry
meta.description: Sixty-four own-authored bass presets in five sections — SUB · REESE · HYBRID · ACID-X · GROWL: clean subs and glide 808s, detuned reese walls, layered VA/hybrid stacks (osc1 + wavetable osc2 + sub with fast filter envelopes and fold/crush drive — no FM operator is shipped, so hybrid = layered oscs + drive), acid crossovers on the shipped acid engine, and driven growls. VA patches ride the osc/filter/env/LFO core plus the FX rack; acid patches ride the acid.* control set. Engine kinds va and acid. Own-authored, CC0.
